evidence: The paper reports "The freeware Ranger that implements the regression algorithm of random forest was used to model the relationships between carbon fluxes and independent variables" and validates using cross-validation (R² metrics) and leave-one-site-out validation, but contains no discussion of variable or feature importance. The Methods section explains how RF selects "splitting points that maximize node impurity" but never reports or interprets impurity-based importance rankings of the predictor variables (LAI, LAI_MIN, LAI_MAX, LAI_COUNT, FAPAR, T2M, RH2M, DSSR).
